title: SAUCE: Synchronous and Asynchronous User-Customizable Environment for Multi-Agent LLM Interaction
reasoning: The paper features a case study (Section 4.2) specifically designed to examine ethical decision-making and dynamics through a group discussion on the classic trolley problem, a fundamental moral dilemma in ethics. It explores how agents weigh moral implications such as the 'greater good' versus the 'sanctity of life'.
